subject: mathematics
overview: Master mathematics from fundamentals through advanced calculus and statistics. Progress from basic algebra and equations to advanced probability, statistics, and mathematical analysis used in engineering and data science.

beginner.name: Beginner
beginner.prerequisites: Basic familiarity with algebraic operations and mathematical notation
beginner.outcomes: Strong foundational knowledge in algebra and linear systems to progress to calculus

intermediate.name: Intermediate
intermediate.description: Application level - Apply concepts to solve problems
intermediate.prerequisites: Completion of all beginner modules with 75%+ average
intermediate.outcomes: Ability to apply calculus to solve engineering and optimization problems

advanced.name: Advanced
advanced.prerequisites: Completion of all intermediate modules with 75%+ average
advanced.outcomes: Professional-level expertise in probability and statistics for data analysis and machine learning

progression_logic: Students must complete all modules in a level with an average quiz score of 75% or higher before advancing to the next level. Each module quiz must be passed with at least 75% to proceed to the next module within the same level.
